params.name: 4Dsignatures
params.description: Data types expressed as internal 4D signatures (e.g. "com.4d.private.picture.gif"); an empty string if a data type is not recognized by 4D.

params.name: nativeTypes
params.description: Data types expressed as native types: UTIs on macOS, or stringified format numbers on Windows.

params.name: formatNames
params.description: Format names/descriptions of the Windows native types, useful for building a format-selection popup menu.

constraints: Intended for use in a drag-and-drop context (On Drop / On Drag Over form events) to check what data types are present in the pasteboard before deciding whether to accept a drop.
